owner: I got a recall notice for my Brightline laptop charger. What do I do?

steps.why: Find the recall from the owner's own words.
steps.text:
3 recalls for "Brightline 65W laptop charger" (elastic search):
1. Recall BH-2026-01, 2026-10-15: Brightline Home recalls 65W laptop chargers (sample recall). Photo refund: Cut the cord, $34.99 refund. {origin}/recalls/BH-2026-01
2. Recall 25248, 2025-05-01: Baseus Portable Chargers Recalled Due to Fire Hazard; Sold on Amazon.com by Shenzhen Baseus Technology. Remedy: Replace. {origin}/recalls/25248
3. Recall 24122, 2024-02-21: Dynabook Americas Recalls 15.5 Million Toshiba Laptop AC Adapters Due to Burn and Fire Hazards. Remedy: Replace. {origin}/recalls/24122

steps.why: Read what the recall asks the owner to do and photograph.
steps.text:
Recall BH-2026-01: Brightline Home recalls 65W laptop chargers (sample recall).
It pays on a photo. First: Cut the cord. Remedy: Full refund of $34.99.
Steps: Unplug the charger. Cut the cord where it meets the charger case. Take one photo of the cut cord with the charger.
Official remedy: "Stop using the charger and cut the power cord where it meets the charger case. Send one photo of the cut cord with the charger for a full refund of $34.99."
Source: stored rule, none (written by the sample firm). Details: {origin}/recalls/BH-2026-01
